[CONTRIBUTION EVENT]
- Type: Time (Minutes)
- Amount: 240
- Description: Black King → TrueTech Rev 12 export docs: unit regen, finalize, and runbook/registry corrections
  
  Pull requests (GitHub evidence):
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/agentic_ai_context/pull/1333
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/agentic_ai_context/pull/1334
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/agentic_ai_context/pull/1335
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/agentic_ai_context/pull/1336
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/agentic_ai_context/pull/1337
  
  Details:
  Prepared, finalized and documented the Rev 12 export documentation set for the Black King (Ilhéus) → TrueTech Inc (SF) cacao consignment, and corrected three items of record in the Brazil→SF freight runbook.
  
  SCOPE OF WORK (thread 10800):
  1. Regenerated the commercial invoice + packing list in the NCM-mandated export units Saymon supplied (1801/1803/1804/1805 → TON; 1802/1806 → KG; 2106.90.00 Cacao Tea stays KG, outside the norm table). USD/BRL values unchanged. Replaced hand-authored Rev 11 PDFs with a reproducible generator (scripts/build_black_king_export_docs.py) so the invoice and packing list cannot drift — both render from one shared LINES/UTRIB table.
  2. Finalized Rev 12: removed the red DRAFT banner, the .draft CSS rule, and all stale hedge wording ("confirm the flagged items", "reconcile against the weighed shipment"); replaced with factual statements (net 344.06 kg / gross 364.06 kg). Verified hedge-free in the RENDERED PDFs, not just the source.
  3. Status pointer + changelog advanced from Rev 11 to Rev 12; Rev 11 marked superseded.
  4. Ranbook/registry corrections (three, each from a real catch):
     a. Recorded the Rev 12 finalize (PR #1335) — previously unlogged; the changelog stopped at #1333, so a future reader would still see Rev 12 as a DRAFT.
     b. Attribution correction: the packing-list-consistency confirmation (PL already follows Saymon's norm by construction) was ENVOY's, not governor Gary Teh's, and is NOT a governor authorization. Gary's verbatim "Ok then make it finalized. Remove the red box" is the actual go behind #1335. Now stated in the durable record.
     c. Delivery-channel correction: Saymon (NF-e specialist) and Jussileide (accountant) are NOT on Telegram — they are contractors on WhatsApp "Black King - Contab" and cannot see thread 10800. Artifacts must be relayed by Gary into WhatsApp; OpenClaw's verified JID list (only The Beer Hall + Prompt Haus) means there is currently no automated delivery path.
  
  EVIDENCE / VERIFICATION:
  - Both Rev 12 PDFs hashed (sha256) and surfaced to thread 10800; delivery of the exact bytes verified.
  - Rendered-PDF scan for DRAFT / "NOT an issued" / "flagged" / "confirm" / "reconcile" → none present.
  - Diff vs main verified hunk-by-hunk (docs-only).
  - compileall clean; ruff clean on touched files (28 pre-existing errors all in untouched Python); pytest 67 passed / 3 failed — 3 reproduced pre-existing on origin/main (docs-only change).
  - handoffs/HANDOFF_MANIFEST.md validation OK (11 pre-existing warnings); index regenerated.
  
  STILL OPEN (human-gated, not part of this submission):
  - Relay Rev 12 PDFs to Saymon via WhatsApp (Gary), then Saymon re-keys emitter units (runbook §5.1a / Appendix E) and re-drafts the NF-e.
  - NF-e issuance gated on Gary's explicit approval (§0.2). Not issued.
  - Weight reconciliation: derived 344.06 kg vs Rev 11's stated ~300 kg — for Saymon to confirm against the weighed shipment.
  
  No production deploy, no money moved, no ledger writes in any of the above.
- Contributor(s): Sophia Truesight
- TDG Issued: 400.00
- Attached Filename: N/A
- Destination Contribution File Location: N/A
--------
